scripts.build:content: bun build src/content/dom-tracker.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/content/dom-tracker.js --minify && bun build src/content/privacy-redactor.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/content/privacy-redactor.js --minify
scripts.build:test: tsc && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development
scripts.test:live: npm run build && bun build tests/legacy/autonomous-extension-audit.ts --outfile tests/legacy/run-audit.mjs --target node && node tests/legacy/run-audit.mjs
scripts.test:qa: npm run build && bun build tests/legacy/autonomous-qa-suite.ts --outfile tests/legacy/run-qa-suite.mjs --target node && node tests/legacy/run-qa-suite.mjs
